scope: Greymane's Gambit 39800 and The Splintered Fleet 39801: native code/data audit, departure/re-entry repair and Horde opening report. No client run requested.
status: Partial repair. Neither whole mission is implemented or client-verified; continue these scenarios before auditing their follow-up quests.
findings: Installed 7.3.5 DB2 data identifies map 1475, Alliance LFG 969/scenario 826 and Horde LFG 998/scenario 824, both difficulty 12. There are five Alliance and six Horde stages. Both quest objectives require one mission-completion marker 113320. Their native final ScenarioStep RewardQuestID values are 39800/39801; no native QUEST_COMPLETE spell effect completes either mission.

Alliance Genn's quest acceptance teleported straight to world map 1220, bypassing scenario 826. Horde Sylvanas set a pending scenario ID then cast 228560. Native effect 45 is PLAY_MOVIE 483; that spell never queues LFG. Scenario data also used unqualified rows for both factions on the same map.

Horde quest flags differed from the native 34603008 by 65544, including AUTOCOMPLETE. Both quests had event-only completion locks. Startup testing additionally exposed seven duplicate zero-delay SCRIPT_COMMAND_QUEST_EXPLORED acceptance rows. The loader re-added the lock and acceptance filled the objective immediately. The scoped migration removes those exact rows and obsolete shortcuts and clears those flag differences.

Departure now uses Rogers' existing conditioned menu 19355/0 for Alliance and Sylvanas' menu 19342/0 or quest acceptance for Horde. Sylvanas' gossip bit is enabled. Interaction validates faction, active quest, capital map, live actor/player, phase, visibility, LOS, proximity, combat and transport state; selection also validates the stored menu/item because the core invokes AI before its own menu validation. Existing rounds/introduction controllers remain integrated.

The Horde movie is retained independently of queueing. Departure waits for completion/skip with a bounded missing-acknowledgement fallback; failed movie casts do not consume progression. Duplicate requests are suppressed. Weak quest lifetimes and generation numbers prevent callbacks from an earlier acceptance consuming a fresh one. Matching active LFG instances can be re-entered; unrelated queues/groups are preserved. Abandoned pending queues are canceled only when their single selected dungeon matches the owned attempt. Logout removes tracking.

On login, an active COMPLETE mission lacking objective 113320 is restored to INCOMPLETE, recovering old premature completion. Already rewarded history and objective-backed COMPLETE states are retained. No departure or report code grants final credit.

Map 1475 has eight installed Horde actor spawns (93486, three 93490, 94419, 94420, 94421, 94517), zero gameobjects, no Alliance actors and no instance script. The native TDB735 archive probe found no map-1475 creature/gameobject spawns either; that archive cannot supply the missing placement graph. Native criteria are script events, so template presence alone cannot implement the combat stages.

The installed Horde opening SmartAI list removed gossip permanently, awarded marker 113320 to every nearby player and teleported them out after a short conversation. A scoped report controller now pins owner, acceptance lifetime and Nathanos GUID, validates both living actors and the current scenario/step at each line, sends the retained five dialogue groups privately and advances only native event 45340 after the final line. Delays use installed text minimum times, including Nathanos' final 31340 ms. Failure resets the attempt while retaining the gossip flag for retry. Other maps/scenarios delegate to SmartAI. Actual client speech playback remains unverified.
